title: Error::RevocationFetchFailed wraps String
description:
In pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:485-488, Error::RevocationFetchFailed carries a description: String field. The variant's rustdoc justifies this ('deliberately a String rather than structured data so the variant remains Clone + PartialEq + Eq'), but per the coding standards, error variants should carry structured fields rather than String messages.

What goes wrong: Callers cannot programmatically inspect failure details (e.g., count of URLs tried, per-URL error kinds) from the revocation-fetch failure. All diagnostic information is lost inside a human-readable string.

Location: pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:485-488

Recommendation: Consider replacing the bare String with a small structured type that preserves programmatic access while keeping Clone + PartialEq + Eq.
